{{Quote|I think&hellip;I might have ruined my life.''"<br />"''Sounds like you've met a woman. Do you want me to leave the bottle?|Jelph Marrian and a Keshiri bartender, who serves the former a mug of sweetwater|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
'''Sweetwater''' was a beverage stored in a bottle and served in a [[Glass/Legends|glass]] mug at a [[Unidentified bar (Kesh)|bar]] located just outside the [[City/Legends|city]] walls of [[Tahv]],<ref name="Sentinel" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kesh system/Legends|Kesh system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jelph Marrian]], [[Water/Legends|dehydrated]] and ravenous, entered the bar as Kesh's [[Star/Legends|sun]] set in [[3960 BBY]], the hovel's [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Unidentified Keshiri bartender|bartender]] poured a mug of sweetwater for the guest, who also received a bowl of [[Porridge/Legends|porridge]].<ref name="Sentinel" />

The bartender observed that Marrian was suffering from a relationship and offered him the remainder of the sweetwater bottle, although the guest remained silent. Secretly a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Marrian had pursued his love interest, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Orielle Kitai]], since the evening of the previous [[Standard day/Legends|day]], when Kitai had rushed to Tahv from Marrian's rural [[Jelph Marrian's farm|farm]] after discovering its hidden [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|Jedi starfighter]]. While Marrian wanted to forget about the event, he realized that sweetwater would not help fulfill his desire. Nevertheless, Marrian drank his mug of sweetwater deeply, replenishing himself before leaving to [[Duel in the Tahv aqueduct|confront]] Kitai in Tahv.<ref name="Sentinel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sweetwater appears in the [[2011]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]'', the sixth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith]]'' series that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Sentinel" />
